items.title: Teaching the Harness: Student-Aware Skill Transfer for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 教授智能体框架：面向 LLM 智能体的学生感知技能迁移
items.summary: Student-Aware Teaching builds a learner model that pairs an empirical profile with hypotheses about a student agent's limitations, tests them with diagnostic probes, and admits reusable skills only when they raise success on matched development tasks. With Claude-Sonnet-5 teaching DeepSeek-V4-Flash it reaches 86.46% task success versus 81.04% for a profile-free teacher and 75.00% for the untaught student, and saved libraries retain gains of up to 11.1 points.

items.title: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases
items.title_zh: ExpertCrowd-SWE：在不熟悉代码库中衡量前沿编程智能体的专家级工程任务
items.summary: ExpertCrowd-SWE is a benchmark of 100 expert-authored, multi-file software engineering tasks drawn from 87 open-source projects in 11 languages, with sealed reference solutions and task-specific weighted graders. Across 3,495 scored runs, Claude Opus 5.5 (67.3%) and GPT-6 Astra (63.7%) lead without a statistically significant gap, while Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Grok 4.6 cluster at 32-34%.

items.title: Veritas: A Verifier Generation Harness for Agent Tasks
items.title_zh: Veritas：面向智能体任务的验证器生成框架
items.summary: Veritas is a harness that automatically generates verifiers for agent tasks by adding an evidence header, a library of domain rules that tasks leave unstated, and authoring principles partly refined through a self-improvement loop. With the model fixed, its verifiers agree better with official verdicts than those of seven other harnesses on all four execution-scored benchmarks.

items.title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
items.title_zh: F3-AGI v4.0：面向样本高效抽象推理的生物能量门控主动推断、元可塑预处理与残差程序合成
items.summary: F3-AGI v4.0 is a CPU-native neuro-symbolic architecture combining mistake-gated plasticity, complexity-guided program synthesis and random-projection-driven expected-free-energy exploration. On the 400-task ARC-AGI-1 public evaluation set it solves 57 tasks (14.25% pass@2) with 1.62 s mean latency and no LLM calls, and it completes all 15 levels of a local ARC-AGI-3-inspired suite.

items.title: AgentScript-Eval: Benchmarking LLMs and Agents for Code Generation in an Enterprise DSL
items.title_zh: AgentScript-Eval：评估 LLM 与智能体在企业 DSL 中代码生成的基准
items.summary: AgentScript-Eval is an execution-graded benchmark of 100 real tasks for AgentScript, the declarative DSL Salesforce uses in Agentforce, covering authoring, debugging and optimizing conversational agents. The best of five zero-shot models reaches only 25.0% pass@3 and all score 0% on authoring from scratch, while an agentic compile-and-edit loop roughly doubles partial-credit accuracy.

items.title: Agreeing on the Answer but Not the Reason: Measurement Limits of LLM Reasoning Failure Taxonomies
items.title_zh: 答案一致但理由不同：LLM 推理失败分类法的测量局限
items.summary: The paper shows that reported shares of an LLM reasoning-failure category can be largely an artifact of the measurement procedure: across six classifier orderings the share of Compositional Collapse spans 26.4% to 76.4%, and native speakers agree with the inspector at kappa 0.932 on answer correctness but only 0.093 on the category. It recommends reporting label co-occurrence, permuting tie-breaks, validating on a shared sample and auditing systematic disagreements.

items.title: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
items.title_zh: ProTEUS：面向闭环蛋白质进化的突变分辨世界模型
items.summary: ProTEUS is a mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution that learns a joint latent representation of sequence, evolutionary and structural information with a mutation-biased attention architecture. In two closed-loop engineering campaigns it produced aldehyde dehydrogenase and levansucrase variants with more than 10-fold higher activity than wild type.

items.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.title_zh: CodeRabbit 借助智能体式软件开发将交付量提升 20 倍
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team, according to OpenAI.

items.title: Cognitive Multi-Agent Search and Rescue: Language-Grounded Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Collaborative Robotics
items.title_zh: 认知多智能体搜救：面向协作机器人的语言接地分层强化学习
items.summary: The paper presents a language-grounded hierarchical reinforcement learning framework in which an LLM turns human instructions into structured semantic cues for UAV and UGV agents, coordinated through a shared cognitive workspace. In simulated disaster experiments it reports 2.3x faster learning, 37% higher coordination coherence and 20-30% higher victim rescue rates.
